learning_outcomes.text: Explain how Claude Code hooks run project-defined commands around actions
Configure hooks to enforce formatting, tests or policy automatically
Keep hooks fast, deterministic and safe to run repeatedly
Debug a failing or misbehaving hook
Decide what belongs in a hook versus a manual step or CI

integrative_case: A team adds a pre-edit hook that runs the formatter and a post-edit hook that runs the affected tests, keeps both fast and deterministic, and debugs a case where a slow hook was blocking every action.
